submit to galleries but i know they are bias im developing a body of abstract work focused on emotional repair and boundaries for me art is healing and its such a passion please be honest and brutal with me is this a hobby and not something that would be taken seriously and if anyone thinks this could be something what should i do with it im at a really weird place in my head about it i numbered them below i know this is a big post i really am just stuck on if its something or if i think its something bc ive poured my heart out with it 1 cathedral window longing a layered abstract featuring a partially revealed face on the right positioned as if looking through a cathedrallike window a gold diagonal divides the surface acting as both barrier and illumination reflecting longing for acceptance and belonging 2 the wound a restrained blue field interrupted by a single red crossshaped rupture the surface holds tension between containment and exposure suggesting injury truth and unresolved repair 3 after the structure fragmented marks and faded geometry evoke a structure after collapse layers of blue and neutral tones reflect instability memory and the quiet aftermath of something once solid 4 eye of the storm a sweeping white arc cuts through scattered color and texture capturing motion and turbulence the piece explores survival momentum and the bodys instinct to move through emotional storms 5 accumulation dense layers of color and texture build across the surface creating a sense of emotional saturation the work reflects lived experience complexity and the beauty found in accumulation rather than clarity 6 intersection bold diagonal stripes and metallic textures cross the canvas emphasizing tension between structure and vulnerability the work explores boundaries pressure points and moments of convergence 7 proximity overlapping circles suggest relationship and connection where each form retains individuality while being shaped by closeness to others the piece reflects balance influence and shared space 8 seed a single concentrated circular form sits within an open field minimal and deliberate the piece reflects beginnings faith and quiet resilience 9 healing is not linear soft diagonal movement passes through muted fields as color blooms beneath the surface the work reflects gradual healing interruption and uneven progress rather than resolution 10 boundary a bold red x dominates the surface asserting finality and protection the piece explores refusal selfpreservation and the moment where crossing lines is no longer permitted

mio memories in orbit douze diximes new metroidvania releasing on january 20 metroidvania lovers this one is for you hi were a french indie studio called douze diximes and after five years of hard work were about to release our upcoming metroidvania mio memories in orbit the game launches in two days on january 20 and we obvisouly wanted to share it with you all for indie sunday before the release whats mio memories in orbit mio memories in orbit is a singleplayer metroidvania that blends challenge and breathtaking sceneries set in a vast and mysterious universe the pitch you play as mio a nimble robot with extroardinary abilities who wakes up in the vessel a space ship drifting aimlessly in space this enormous technological ark whose initial purpose remains unknown lies now as a field of ruins overgrown with lush vegetation and machines gone rogue and nobody knows why the pearls the vessels ai caretakers have ceased functioning forgotten by all the vessel faces imminent shutdown to uncover what happened to the ship and to yourself you will have to let your curiosity guide you as you discover the vessels dark secrets and pathways will you rise to the challenge and save the vessel from oblivion will you dare to seek and wake its memories whats combat progression like you will face off a diverse array of over 30 enemy units and 15 formidable guardian bosses from the relentless mosquito to the menacing scarecrow get ready to confront a variety of deadly adversaries each with their own distinct fighting styles and movement patterns to defeat them use your arsenal of powers to adapt to every encounter evade foes using your hairpin unleash orbs as powerful projectiles or even create decoy clones to strike from unexpected angles you will be able to enhance and customize mios abilities by scavenging enemy components spice up your fighting skills with many modifiers and transform mio into a formidable force tailored to your playstyle would you make your grappling hairpin a deadly lasso or an evade move sacrifice your shield to boost your damage its always your choice fans of hollow knight celeste dead cells will feel right at home the game environment with multiple biomes secrets and shortcuts to discover as a gigantic labyrinth the vessel is a true living organism with its own ecosystems bestiaries and architectures you will need to master precision rythm and timing and also use a variety of abilities like grappling hook air gliding or spiderlike wall clinging to help mio progress through this twisted and interconnected space from historic charm to modern luxury arkansas homes for every taste arkansas often referred to as the natural state offers a stunning variety of landscapes and an equally diverse range of homes from charming historical residences nestled in quaint towns to luxurious modern estates perched atop scenic hills the state caters to various preferences and lifestyles whether youre a history buff an outdoor enthusiast a modernist architect admirer or someone simply seeking peace and tranquility arkansas has something to offer this article explores the unique characteristics of homes in arkansas highlighting the states rich architectural history trends in modern luxury living and everything in between a tapestry of historical charm arkansas is steeped in rich history reflected in its architectural landscape from the antebellum period to the early 20th century the homes in many parts of the state showcase a variety of historical styles making them a delight for history enthusiasts and those who appreciate fine craftsmanship 1 antebellum estates the antebellum period in arkansas particularly in the cotton kingdom produced some remarkable homes these estates often characterized by large columns symmetrical designs and expansive porches exude a sense of grandeur the tucker house in little rock is a prime example showcasing an elegant blend of greek revival style with southern charm with its historical significance and picturesque settings antebellum homes often stand as symbols of arkansas rich agricultural heritage 2 victorian elegance the victorian era left a significant mark on arkansas especially in towns like eureka springs and little rock these homes often feature intricate woodwork bold colors and decorative gables the piney woods victorian home in eureka springs with its captivating porch and vibrant window displays serves as a reminder of the eras artistic expression restorations and renovations often breathe new life into these historical gems making them both functional living spaces and storied pieces of the past 3 craftsman comfort moving into the early 20th century the craftsman style became popular emphasizing simplicity and craftsmanship homes designed in this style such as those found in the hillcrest neighborhood of little rock focus on horizontal lines exposed woodwork and builtin furniture the natural materials and earthy tones of craftsman homes create warm inviting atmospheres appealing to families seeking comfort and harmony with nature 4 the rise of bungalows bungalows often smaller and more intimate than their victorian counterparts gained popularity in the early 1900s in neighborhoods like garland avenue in little rock youll find charming bungalows adorned with porches and cozy interiors these homes are characterized by their practicality and ease of maintenance making them ideal for firsttime homeowners or those seeking a lowkey lifestyle the essence of southern living southern architecture has a unique flair that melds comfort with charm and many arkansas homes embody this essence the traditional southern home often includes wide porches spacious interiors and sprawling yards fostering community and family gatherings 1 farmhouses and country retreats in rural areas traditional farmhouses dot the landscape standing as testaments to the states agricultural roots properties such as the old stone farmhouse near mount ida embody rustic charm with modern comforts featuring spacious kitchens wraparound porches and stunning views of rolling farmland these homes often become sanctuaries for those looking to escape the hustle of city life while immersing themselves in nature 2 southern hospitality in modern homes contemporary interpretations of southern architecture blend traditional elements with modern design homes like those found in bentonville showcase wideopen spaces large windows and a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor areas these houses often feature smart home technology while retaining the warm inviting qualities characteristic of southern living embracing modern luxury while arkansas is rich in historical homes it also presents many modern luxury homes designed to meet contemporary aesthetics and lifestyle needs these residences offer various amenities and features that appeal to todays discerning buyers 1 architectural masterpieces in cities like fayetteville and little rock sleek designs and innovative materials define the modern luxury market the tiller house in fayetteville is an architectural masterpiece with clean lines sophisticated finishes and an open floor plan that invites an abundance of natural light such homes often incorporate ecofriendly technologies appealing to sustainabilityminded buyers 2 open concept living modern luxury homes often embrace the open concept design which encourages social interaction and creates a vast airy atmosphere spaces that seamlessly connect the living area dining room and kitchen are particularly popular this layout works beautifully for entertaining making these homes ideal for hosting gatherings and enjoying quality time with loved ones 3 outdoor living spaces the allure of the outdoors is strong in arkansas and many modern homes incorporate stunning outdoor spaces patios decks and infinity pools properties such as those in hot springs village often take full advantage of the states natural beauty by providing picturesque views overlooking lakes or mountains outdoor kitchens and fire pits augment these spaces creating an ideal atmosphere for al fresco dining and relaxation 4 smart technologies and sustainability as technology advances so does the luxury home market many arkansas homes are now equipped with smart home technologies that enhance security convenience and energy efficiency features such as smart lighting thermostat systems and security cameras are increasingly prevalent additionally sustainable materials and energyefficient designs are priorities for those buying luxury homes aligning with a growing commitment to environmental responsibility housing trends and future developments while arkansas has a rich historical legacy it does not shy away from embracing what lies ahead developing trends and changing lifestyles are shaping the future of housing in the state 1 adaptive reuse repurposing and renovating existing structures have emerged as a proactive approach to sustainability and urban revitalization cities like little rock are witnessing the transformation of old warehouses and factories into chic lofts and modern apartments this adaptive reuse respects historical architecture while accommodating contemporary needs 2 communitycentric developments some new developments reflect a shift towards creating more communitycentric environments neighborhoods now prioritize walkability and accessibility ensuring that residents can easily engage with their surroundings features such as parks communal spaces and local marketplaces enrich the living experience fostering a deeper sense of community 3 emphasizing green spaces as urbanization spreads a growing emphasis on green spaces is essential parks community gardens and nature trails are being integrated into residential developments arkansas communities are taking proactive measures to establish more green areas for residents enjoyment ultimately enhancing quality of life conclusion a home for everyone from historic charm to modern luxury the homes in arkansas reflect the states rich cultural tapestry and diverse lifestyle options whether you fall in love with a victorian masterpiece or seek out a sleek modern abode arkansas caters to every taste the essence of faith in tradition coupled with the pursuit of modernity creates a place where history is cherished while simultaneously embracing the future for those looking to find their dream home arkansas is more than just a destinationits an opportunity to find a unique slice of history indulgent luxury or an inviting community with its blend of natural beauty rich heritage and modern advancements the state promises a setting where anyone can feel at home additional information

on the topic of religious education in public schools specifically in austria and germany well hello there ever wanted to learn about religious school education in two countries if so continue reading if not just dont yesterday there was a thread by an austrian user uspecificspiritual637 about the perceived lack of jewish historical and religious education in austrian public schools many replies showed understandable confusion from the majority nongermanaustrian users since the way religious education works here is quite different from what most people are used to im starting this thread to somewhat briefly clarify the two systems in these countries history germany and austria are an outlier when it comes to religious education in europe this has obvious historical reasons due to the fact how the land was administered after the peace of westphalia the peace of westphalia 1648 helped establish the principle that rulers could determine the religion of their territories which laid the groundwork for confessional divisions in germanspeaking lands including separate religious education in schools and how parts of this later influenced the respective first republics of those two countries borders after the peace of westphalia religious distribution after the peace of westphalia today in german and austrian schools religious education is separated according to denominationreligion this means that religion is a school subject like any other in german and austrian schools this means that pupils are graded in this subject just like in any other subject as in other subjects this grade determines whether or not the pupil will be promoted to the next level at the end of the school year if a pupil is catholic they attend catholic religious education organised by the school the same applies if they are evangelical lutheran united and reformed or muslim only logically in the religious education of the respective denominationreligion the state works with the religious communities to set the curriculum for these subjects this subject is generally mandatory but a pupil can request exemption exempted pupils then take part in the substitute subject usually ethics or practical philosophy depends on the schoolstate in germany and probablyperhaps also in austria but i am not sure about that it is also possible for pupils to attend religious education classes of a different denominationreligion they are then involved in the lessons in the same way as the other pupils and are graded in the same way generally germany and austria are largely the same when it comes to this with one exemption in austria education is regulated by the federal government in germany education is regulated by the respective federal states meaning that there are 16 education ministries throughout the country some of which issue different education plans plus one education ministry for the entire country in berlin however this ministry has far less power than its counterpart in austria i personally as most other jewish pupils in germany and likely austria have never really gone through this public school curriculum due to the simple fact that we are the tiniest minority at practically every public school though it technically also exists and is valid for the separate jewish schools in the country it is obviously a bit different there as jewish schools are majority jewish duh so the jewish identity really is omnipresent even outside of religious education i personally attended a public school and as a subject had practical philosophy so i also found it interesting to read about the for me theoretical jewish religious education at a german public school so now you know about the general systems and are probably wondering what is being taught for that i will choose the example of my own state north rhinewestphalia in germany as mentioned above this will differ from german state to german state though largely aligned various religious education classes exist in schools but not all of them are offered as a matter of course this has always to do with the number of pupils at the respective school if theres only one or two students of a denominationreligion the school is not mandated to organise a class for these few students these pupils then usually take part in the substitute subject ethics or practical philosophy the currently existing curricula are as follows alevite religious education evangelical lutheran united and reformed religious education islamic religious education jewish religious education catholic religious education orthodox religious education syrian orthodox religious education if your denominationreligion is not mentioned you automatically qualify for the substitute subject or are obviously free to attend one of the available subjects as germany has been historically but is still largely catholic and evangelical lutheran united and reformed dominated you will find catholic and evangelical lutheran united and reformed religious education at every public school though i assume there are exceptions to the rule in some towns and cities where one of the two is dominant though perhaps not any more it should be noted that catholicism and evangelicalism lutheran united and reformed are in a practical freefall of their members throughout germany i assume that in the near future subjects like ethics and practical philosophy will be far more common than they are now this also explains the situation uspecificspiritual637 found themselves in the content of these school subjects is tailored to the respective denominationreligion i will describe the content of jewish religious education as a subject mainly because i am jewish myself but also because jews in the other thread did not really understand what the subject might be about to this end i will quote passages from the curriculum for jewish religious education in primary school it explains relatively clearly what the school subject is about the same exists for secondary schools but that will obviously be a bit more advanced of course it differs from the catholic or islamic subjects at the same school but the guidelines for the subjects are the same you simply have to replace the content in your head with that of another or your denominationreligion ie jewish prayerholidays catholic prayerholidays islamic prayerholidays etc 1 tasks and objectives of the subject 11 the contribution of jewish religious education to the educational mandate jewish religious education contributes to identity formation this is achieved through the imparting of knowledge concrete action and cooperation with parents and the jewish community specifically this means encouraging pupils to perceive judaism as an actionoriented religion that has a place in the reality of the childs life to treat other people with respect acceptance and openness to develop their technical language skills enabling them to respect other religions and world views alongside their own based on their experience of the plurality of the jewish religion supporting them in building a relationship with the land of israel supporting them in developing an awareness of intrajewish diversity 2 areas and focal points the curriculum divides the subject of jewish religious instruction into the following seven areas torah jewish annual cycle shabbat prayer tfila synagogue responsible behaviour land of israel 21 torah the torah is the central source in judaism therefore the contents of the torah can be found in all areas and its stories teachings and commandments and prohibitions mitzvot connect the areas with one another the stories of the torah not only serve to convey values but also convey a relationship with god as the sole creator who works both through miracles and through his demands on humans as his partners in creation against this background students learn about the torah and engage with it the focus is on stories of the torah commandments and prohibitions mitzvot 22 jewish annual cycle the jewish annual cycle is linked to the jewish calendar as the holidays are tied to specific seasons eg passover as a festival that takes place in spring the regularity of the holidays conveys a sense of continuity and they are experienced and learned in a lively manner in everyday school life the focus is on jewish holidays the jewish calendar 23 shabbat shabbat as the holiest day of the week and a day of rest following the creation is a day of rest for humans but also for animals and the environment shabbat is a day that is concerned with both the commandments between humans and god and the commandments between humans and their fellow humans bejn adam lamakom and bejn adam lechavero prayers and torah readings take place in the synagogue at home this is a time when the family is together in class pupils are encouraged to integrate the idea of shabbat as a day when parents and children have time for each other into their everyday lives and to experience it positively the focus is on the content and sequence of shabbat shabbat prayers 24 prayer tfila prayers and blessings book review nr 26 horus heresy mechanicum the kaban machine welcome the 26th book review of this vlog today im reviewing mechanicum and the kaban project which can be found in the shadows of pretty clear what this story will be about but i still think the techpriest could have been done much better especially with the aesthetics games workshop have gone for the last 10 years or so at the who are loyal to the imperium believing in reasoning and truth and the traitors who sided with horus and dabbles with forbidden techsorcery the problem with this book is from the beginning we dont himself with that so the story is wellwritten it does have a connection and bigger impact on the overall story and a great ending i will give it 7 forks out of 10 now over to the kaban project which is sort of a prequel to mechanicum we follow the character of lukas chrom one of the bad guys from mechanicum who is building himself a sentient mechanical lifeform called the kaban the kaban later reviewing every death battle ever part 75 power rangers vs voltron part 75 power rangers vs voltron oh man now this is a battle that had an insane amount of hype behind it megazord versus voltron or power rangers vs voltron as the youtube title calls it is one of those matchups that had years of buildup behind it and honestly rightfully so they even say it themselves at the beginning of the episode this was one of the most anticipated and biggest matchups in death battle history and lets be real death battle almost never says that about an episode so the moment they open with that statement you already know theyre about to pull out all the stops this wasnt just another episode this was supposed to be special we start with the power rangers and we get a rundown of how the entire universe began rita repulsa evil space witch extraordinaire gets sealed away in what is essentially a galactic dumpster which is still one of the funniest villain imprisonments of all time but of course zordon knows thats not going to hold forever so he comes up with a backup plan recruit five teenagers to fight an intergalactic threat now in any normal context that is an absolutely insane plan and honestly its still insane within power rangers logic but somehow it works those five teenagers draw their power from the morphin grid and become the power rangers we learn about each ranger individually their personalities what theyre good at and the zords they pilot and look ill be honest here my favorites have always been the tyrannosaurus and the mastodon maybe thats an unpopular opinion but i dont care theyre cool as hell but the real highlight of the analysis comes when individual strength just isnt enough and the rangers combine into one of the single coolest things from anyones childhood the megazord this thing is absurdly cool it can fire lasers punch massive monsters into the air shoot even more lasers out of its eyes and use the mastodons head as a shield yes a shield i told you this thing rules if the megazord ever finds itself in trouble it can summon the power sword which not only boosts its offensive power but also completely recharges it on top of that the sword can reflect kinetic energy back at attackers essentially turning it into a giant counter weapon and lets not forget just how strong this thing actually is punching monsters of equal size hundreds of feet into the air is absurd the sheer strength required to do that is insane now sure the megazord moves kind of clunky gets hit a lot and tends to run out of power at inconvenient times but honestly i cant bring myself to hate it its just too fucking cool then we move on to voltron and while its origin is similar in some ways it still stands on its own voltron was created through a mix of magic and technology to fend off a universeconquering armada and it did so by itself that alone should tell you how powerful this thing is naturally the emperor of the fleet zarkon wasnt happy about that and hired an evil witch to destroy voltron the attempt didnt fully succeed but it did split voltron into five separate lions those lions crashland on the planet eris where through one of those perfect scifi coincidences five space explorers just happen to land as well they encounter a mysterious princess who helps them bond with the lions reforming voltron once again we get introduced to the pilots keith lance hunk allura and pidge while i obviously grew up more familiar with the power rangers i actually really like the voltron pilots too even though i mostly learned about them through this episode each pilot has a distinct personality and honestly pidge ended up being one of my favorites hes such an erratic hothead and it really shows later in the fight voltrons arsenal is ridiculous flamethrowers lasers missiles and the ability to manifest weapons out of thin air a spinning blade wheel javelins nunchucks but of course the blazing sword is the real star of the show voltron is also insanely durable and strong it punches massive machines into the sky destroys satellites far larger than itself and tanks explosions capable of wiping out entire countries its peak earlyanime insanity and honestly we love that here but its biggest weakness is also very obvious if you hit it precisely enough you can detach one of its limbs basically it comes apart like an action figure which speaking from very specific personal experience is exactly what youd do to your nephews toy when you were mad at him and hid the piece somewhere in your room hypothetically of course now we get to the fight itself and it starts with the voltron pilots scouting a planet in lion form and then wait holy shit is that matpat voicing keith yeah this voice cast is stacked absolutely stacked amalee the black video game nerd peanutbuttergamer kaiserneko space hamster lanipator the list just keeps going practically every character has a recognizable name attached to them and that alone shows how much effort went into this episode the power rangers swoop in as the aggressors striking their iconic poses before instantly summoning their zords and forming the megazord voltron responds in kind and right away this is a moment watching these two massive mechs assemble is hype as hell and its done in a way that clearly respects their source material and yes these are custom models and they look fantastic the action itself is very power rangersesque slightly clunky movements heavy attacks that take effort and time to execute but instead of being a flaw it actually gives the fight a ton of character every punch feels deliberate voltron gets slammed into the ground fires spinning blades lasers and flamethrowers while the megazord counters with reflected energy and heavy blows the destruction the explosions and the sound design are all on point it really sells the scale of this fight the megazord reflects voltrons lasers using the mastodon head then summons the power sword from the sky which hilariously smacks voltron in the back on its way down voltron retaliates by summoning the blazing sword and the sword clash that follows is just chefs kiss it looks incredible sounds incredible and the music blasting in the background elevates it even furtherthe power rangers hesitate when voltron doesnt go down after the kinetic reflection and voltron immediately capitalizes on that opening the two clash again blades flying sparks everywhere until the megazord finally knocks the sword from voltrons hands voltron charges drags the megazord through the ground and hurls it into a wall the megazord responds with lasers and freezes one of voltrons arms to the wall slicing off the other leaving voltron vulnerable but pidge absolutely comes in clutch breaking free from the frozen limb and punching the megazord square in the face keith takes command orders a full assault and matpats line delivery here is genuinely great voltron overwhelms the megazords energy reflection delivers a decisive final slash and finishes the fight in a massive explosion with voltron standing tall in the foreground like an absolute legend not gory but incredibly flashy and now we talk about the music this episode marks the beginning of death battles shift toward original tracks with brandon yates becoming a frequent collaborator stronger together is an incredible addition incorporating the power rangers leitmotif over hard rock building energy toward the finale and massively enhancing the hype this is something ill be talking about more in future reviews especially from thor vs wonder woman onward when death battle fully commits to original tracks hell i might even rank them someday the conclusion itself is solid based on durability alone the megazord simply couldnt keep up with voltron voltron was tougher could tank more damage and ultimately had the firepower to finish the job and honestly thats fine this episode feels like a celebration a passion project bigname voice actors custom models original music and genuine love poured into every aspect of it it looks awesome sounds awesome and feels special thats why without hesitation im giving it a 92100

grammynominated alarm will sound with two mu professors to perform in columbia a group of 20 musicians called alarm will sound who have been nominated for a grammy award will bring their contemporary music to columbia on tuesday the ensemble includes two university of missouri music professors cellist stefan freund and clarinetist bill kalinkos both founding members of the group the free performance begins at 730 pm tuesday in the sinquefield music center on mizzous campus alarm will sound prides itself on performing innovative often genrebending music by composers from around the world the group often collaborates with experimental composers writers and visual artists to perform a wide range of music from electronic pop to experimental classical often adding video theater and other multimedia its an interesting hybrid of the color for an orchestra with the individuality of a chamber ensemble said freund a professor of composition at mizzou were a very sort of eclectic ensemble in terms of the styles we play often the use of onstage visuals memorization rhythmic elements and elaborate set design engages the audience with the music if its a passive experience its not as effective freund said and we do a lot of things to try to make the music more active to make it grab the audience this year the ensemble is nominated for best chamber musicsmall ensemble performance for their album donnacha dennehy land of winter dennehy who is nominated for best contemporary classical composition at the grammys wrote the music the grammy awards will take place at 7 pm feb 1 the award show will be available to watch on cbs or paramount the ensemble has partnered with the irish composer on a number of works earning the grammy nomination for the album felt especially good because of his continued collaboration said kalinkos a clarinet instructor at mizzou in a way it validates all the work weve been doing for the past 25 years freund added the beginning the ensemble began at the eastman school of music in rochester new york after being founded by a group of peers who wanted to give contemporary composers the opportunity to hear their music performed they started a student organization at eastman called ossia new music which still puts on regular concerts by contemporary composers as graduation came around for many of the groups founding members some wanted to continue their musical work together since then alarm will sound has produced 19 albums i really feel that more has stayed the same than it has changed freund said though if i look in the mirror i probably see some change he emphasized that shared goals and stable leadership are key reasons the orchestra has enjoyed success though the ensemble is based in brooklyn new york the musicians have maintained separate careers often in teaching positions around the country for example elizabeth stimpert teaches clarinet at the university of central missouri because of the distance the group has to coordinate the performance schedule from afar i like to say missouri is the center of american music freund said kansas city and st louis you cant tell the story of american music without missouri when composers submit music through one of the ensembles initiatives kalinkos the groups librarian will file and organize the music for approval by the groups members the music is distributed and when the ensemble meets in person ahead of a tour date or workshop they must be prepared for multiple days of rehearsal professional musicians frequently have to learn their individual parts before they get together for rehearsals and concerts but the complexity of alarm will sounds music can make learning it ahead of time somewhat daunting because the members live in so many places whenever they are together for a performance they usually take time to workshop pieces that may be performed at a later date this past week they spent five days rehearsing on campus ahead of tuesdays concert typically a musicians part for any composition even in heavily improvisational music is written down on a page using a set of standard musical notation the piece by baker workshopped this week forgoes typical written musical notation for that piece im going to be wearing earbuds and each player has their own part that is a recorded vocal track that elizabeth made for us freund said and she is telling us what to do new music at mizzou freund is also the artistic director of the mizzou new music initiative which promotes new composers in missouri through composition competitions scholarships and programs the mizzou new music ensemble which freund directs performs some of the music that the initiative fosters and shares similar stated goals with alarm will sound and ossia new music kalinkos is codirector of the mizzou creative improvisation collective where he applies his experience with alarm will sound to teach music improvisation to students he has lived in columbia since 2014 and also teaches clarinet at mizzou it seems like composers are asking more and more for performers to just improvise kalinkos said maybe theyll give us a collection of pitches or theyll give characteristics they want but leave it very open for the performer to create what they feel on the spot alarm will sound performs annually in columbia as part of the mizzou international composers festival where they have served as the ensembleinresidence since the festival began in 2010 the festival features the world premiere of eight pieces written by composers selected from an international pool of hundreds the pieces are written specifically for alarm will sound so many composers apply from all over to be here for only eight spots kalinkos said its amazing how many people are writing music at the festival each year two additional guest composers usually better known than the eight selected international composers are also featured dennehy has served as the guest composer twice in 2012 and 2019 what to expect during tuesdays concert the group will perform three pieces one respiration by john fitz rogers was written during the covid19 pandemic its very improvisatory and things dont have to line up perfectly kalinkos said it will be interesting to play where everybody is in the same room together a piece by sanaya ardeshir professionally known as sandunes is titled tower of silence and will be a world premiere this week the third is le voci sottovetro voices under glass by salvatore sciarrino which explores the space between sound and silence alarm will sound is planning to release three albums this year the first of which will be a collection of compositions from members of the ensemble to be released this spring

book review 20 horus heresy the first heretic word bearerslorgar aurelian welcome the 20th book review of this vlog today im looking at the book the first heretic written by aaron demskibowden by the time this was announced i think he had only written cadian blood his first novel the short story shadow knight and soul hunter so its a pretty big deal to be accepted into the horus heresygang and it proved to be highly successful as it reached the new yorks bestsellinglist and one can understand why lets see what this book is all about amidst the galaxywide war of the great crusade the emperor castigates the word bearers for their worship distraught at this judgement lorgar and his legion seek another path while devastating world after world venting their fury and fervour on the battlefield their search for a new purpose leads them to the edge of the material universe where they meet ancient forces far more powerful than they could have imagined having set out to illuminate the imperium the corruption of chaos takes hold and their path to damnation begins unbeknownst to the word bearers their quest for truth contains the very roots of heresy so this book is quite expansive as it spans over 40 years of storytelling we follow the word bearers as they are chastised for worshipping the emperor as a god this leads to cruel bitterness as their entire world falls apart this leads for lorgar primarch of the word bearers to find a new thing to believe in under strict watch by the emperors custodians we see as the legion travel the entire galaxy to find this when they come upon the world of cadia they find it the main character of the novel is called argel tal the assaultcaptain of the word bearers 7th company they are the first astartes to explore the deep space called the eye of terror we will then follow their travel from there up until the battle for isstvan v unlike fulgrim which explored the 4 first traitor legions and the 1st attackwave most specifically the iron hands this explores the 2nd wave and more specifically the raven guards slaughter people could have nagged on this story for walking backwards and exploring things we already knew not moving the story forwards like for instant descent of angels but this story explores why and how the heresy started in the first place the title even is interesting as it raises a lot of questions like who is the first heretic is it lorgar for being the first primarch to fall is it kor phaeron and erebus for being the astartes corrupting lorgar or is it argel tal for being the first to meet with the powers of the warp the story is highly detailed and far from bolter porn we have interesting characters as well the word bearers have in the past had slight issue of becoming typical saturday morning cartoon villains very 2 dimensional and stiff aaron demskibowden made them more complex and likable and it feels he is good with this changing the stereotypes of the traitor legions like the word bearers and the night lords thats why it will be interesting to see how he deals with the black legion in the future this was before i had read those books its a tragedy but not in the way like the previous novels for good or bad in the opening trilogy we truly felt the betrayal as the people were slaughtered by horus warriors and loyalist barely escaped in time we never felt that here here we felt the tragic relationship between argel tal and a human called cyrene i wont go into detail too much about here other than that she is the first to break the stereotypical bad ass women aaron demskibowden usually go for in his stories i think they form the closest we ever get to see as a loving relationship but the storys ending is mindblowing going out with a crowning moment between the word bearers and the custodians so a great story interesting characters to work with especially since the past has painted them up differently and a great expansion to the overall storyline this is highly recommended a slight mentioning should be done as one of my favorite scenes in this book is that between lorgar and magnus the red here they change places of who is out of line and who is there to put him back into it unlike a thousand sons this gave me high hopes that aaron demskibowden could just as easily pull off a great thousand sons story just as he has done with the previous traitor legions or graham mcneill did with magnus link to my original reivew up on patreon

social media perhaps that was the last bit of consideration you left for me the photo showed you and your new partner it also showed the things you once held back from the things i compromised on for revealing a side of yourself you had never shown before maybe you felt misunderstood maybe you felt hurt and maybe when i said you didnt care you chose to show me what it looked like when you truly trying to say was that i wanted you to cherish the time we had together more despite our different schedules it was never about believing that you didnt care perhaps my words put pressure on you perhaps that pressure came from insecurity that had already been quietly growing inside me sometimes i feel like we came from different worlds we met through volleyball but you had already let it go long ago in the end what held us together was nothing but our feelings for each other you were born into privilege accustomed to being cared for and served later on you began to change investing more and more in your appearance showcasing your wealth pursuing cosmetic treatments and i felt more and more lost that growing sense of distance was something i couldnt fully understand and couldnt put into words all i could do was try to keep up with you at my own pace when you chose to travel abroad with your friends for the first time i remembered how every time i had suggested going abroad with you you said you needed your own space i respected that but the disappointment never really went away when it was finally our turn to travel together i was filled with anticipation in the fifteen days before our departure even though we were both in taipei we didnt see each other i didnt ask i told myself you were recharging but once the trip started what i felt was your impatience your coldness your absence you noticed it and apologized but you also said that my sullen expression made you feel pressured i wasnt just reacting to that moment i was thinking about what lay beneath it about how our relationship had come to feel this way you had never been impatient with me before on that trip we were constantly in different spaces almost as if it were deliberate when i was upstairs you were downstairs when i went down you went up you edited photos in the living room i rested alone in bed even at night we didnt fall asleep together we felt like people traveling side by side not lovers that was the first time i clearly sensed a distance that couldnt even be called friendship looking back i realize the signs were there much earlier we stopped sharing the little moments you would step away to smoke you became less present even during intimacy i knew you you respond better to gentleness than force you are proud and decisive yet soft and sensitive underneath thats why i never demanded anything i gave you space i encouraged you to make friends i encouraged you to pursue your dreams i just never imagined that what i believed would hold us together would quietly fail maybe i hurt you maybe there were moments when i made you uncomfortable maybe i wasnt always the person you needed me to be but i never took our relationship lightly i stayed present even when things became difficult i didnt walk away when it got hard even bringing up the breakup wasnt an act of giving up it was the last way i knew to try and save what we had i thought that creating some distance stepping back might help us see more clearly where things had gone wrong but in the end i realized something i hadnt expected the harder i tried the lonelier i felt inside after the breakup i didnt blame you for not loving me anymore but i did blame you for not trying to repair what we had for not expressing what you were thinking for choosing silence withdrawal and giving up i blamed you for the way you treated the person who had stood beside you for six years i blamed you so deeply that at times i even wished we had never met you said you would never blame me for initiating the breakup trip report 2 weeks in copenhagen stockholm and london hello folks im back with another trip report i find it to be a great way to reflect on my experience and i enjoyed engaging with the community my previous report is here i was in europe for a longer period and visited more places then background going into this trip i had 2 objectives 1 decompress and unwind from the year even though it had only been 6 months since i left europe there were several life changes that left me depleted and i wanted some alone time which would be almost impossible to have back home this was also why i chose cities that i was familiar with i didnt have the headspace to figure out the logistics of a new location 2 engage with art and culture while i visited several museums and culture spots during my prior travels copenhagen stockholm and london were more akin to daily living cities where i actively avoided spending money or paying for experiences so i wanted to immerse myself in it this time around finances i spent 56k usd in total flights accommodation experiences etc this was fully selffunded by my savings and earnings from internships this was definitely steeper than my prior travels but i did this because i dont know when ill be able to have an extended period to solo travel in the foreseeable future thus i decided to be more flexible in my budget highlights navigating the danish medical system by some amazing oversight i had forgotten to bring my daily prescription medication however the overall process was very smooth i visited the apotek who directed me to a specific teleconsultation platform for noncitizens and i ordered collected my medication at an apotek of my choice i went through this route as i dont have a civil personal registrationsocial security number happy to share more about the costprocess if anyone is interested staying at an airbnb with 2 cats in stockholm i chose a specific livedin airbnb at a residential area because it was home to 2 cats having never lived with pets it was an absolute highlight of my travels id wake up to them sitting beside me or on my chest i loved hearing the pitterpatter of their paws across the wooden floor while i went about my day and i loved observing how they sought sources of warmth in the cold swedish winter whether it be sitting near radiators or chasing the rare sunbeam christmas in the nordics i knew that the nordics celebrated christmas differently and some of my friends wondered why i would spend my days there since most things are closed this was intentional i wanted to be completely alone and in a quiet environment of course christmas has generally been commercialised but the atmosphere felt much more cozy in denmark and sweden you get the sense that friends are gathering together and people are going home to their families in the days leading up to it the streets are naturally crowded but i remember walking along gamla stan on christmas and there was almost no one it was both lonely and heartening at the same time i had purposely flown abroad to process some personal losses and at the same time it warmed me to know that people were at home celebrating with their loved ones logistically speaking supermarkets and essential services were operating as per usual but most fb places were closed some restaurants had an extended break until after the new year so thats something to note if youre travelling during this period west end autograph i unexpectedly managed to catch a play that i had studied in school many years ago id previously heard of how its possible to get of british culinary history detour in dubai due to operational delays i ended up missing my connecting flight back home and had to stay in dubai for 8 hours thankfully the airline emirates handled it silent hill downpour is actually very underrated and many of its problems are simply misunderstandings four years ago in honor of the games tenth anniversary i wrote an article about it in russian and heres the translation i apologize in advance for any errors as english isnt my native itll be a long one with some minor spoilers hope that my interpretation will help to look at this game in a slightly different light it really wasnt that bad and actually quite good justified cruelty in silent hill 2 the only human encounter took place near the end and was meant to knock the wind out of the players sails forcing them to think about james in a completely different light downpour plays this card first the opening scene sets the player against the hero which is a bold move right from the start murphy pendleton an inmate with the players hands brutally dispatches an overweight guy in the shower pendleton unceremoniously beats the stranger with fists and a club plunges a kitchen knife into his shoulder and finishes off the unfortunate victim with a shiv mentioning only that they were neighbors and the guy knows what hes dying for this stark contrast with the typically positive protagonists of the series was meant to immediately show that downpour is something completely new not just another attempt to ride on the coattails of old ideas the developers at vatra games took a rather daring gamble by offering a criminal as the main character early focus group tests showed that not all players felt comfortable controlling an outright bad guy which was exactly the intended effect the reasons for pendletons cruelty are gradually revealed through flashbacks that the hero experiences during his journey these flashbacks deliver the lions share of the backstory to the player in a surprisingly natural way avoiding the usual sense of being forcefed exposition by the finale the full picture of what led murphy to the foggy town becomes clear herein lies something that sets the game apart from other entries in the series a fake hero the original silent hill told the story of a father who lost his daughter and the nightmare of the town was created by the sufferings of the unfortunate girl alessa the sequel was about a widower led to silent hill by a letter from his dead wife with its otherworld shaped by his diseased mind the third part returned to alessa and reflected her personal torments against this backdrop the fourth game with a random victim of the maniac walter sullivan as the hero looked unusual downpour takes this idea even further offering as the hero the primary culprit of problems in the life of a completely different character moreover murphy himself carries a burden in his soul that manifests in certain issues but his sins and fears are much lighter than those of other protagonists pendleton is confident in his righteousness and doesnt particularly grieve over the fate of the offender he took revenge on therefore you wont find any manifestation of guilt in the form of a dangerous monster here downpour often gets criticized for its boring monsters the creatures here can be counted on one hand and the most formidable of them is a mysterious red glow that sucks in everything around it and pursues murphy in his nightmares the rest look rather simple by the series standards these are screaming women wrapped in bandages eversmiling inmates and strange anthropomorphic creatures that feel equally at home on the floor or the ceiling and this is surprisingly logical what might an average person fear in their life the allconsuming emptiness of losing a loved one the screams of a oncebeloved spouse and the torment of guilt from the desire to hide from everyone in murphys case who intentionally ended up behind bars the aggressive inmates representing the greatest danger deserve special mention and somewhere on the horizon lurks repressed sexual desire expressed in the form of mannequin monsters but there are no more complex nightmares in pendletons life there is no place in his silent hill for suppressed childhood fears unbearable burdens of guilt or terror of adults the only personal fear in the form of that very napier seen in the first scene he eliminates with his own hands prison is hell murphys personal hell is full of cages and bars and while the monsters personify some extremely basic things and the heros lack of imagination the otherworld an important part of every personal silent hill takes its full toll on him alessas nightmare from the first silent hill was rust and blood coexisting with omnipresent traces of firea consequence of the monstrous ritual in which she was almost completely burned alive for james the hero of the sequel his personal hell looked musty and moldy with monstrous humidityhe saw his suppressed memories hidden behind a wall of water pendletons hell is a strange almost escherlike prison construct that appears in place of the familiar world while all other heroes traveled through familiar places in an unfamiliar setting murphy found himself in a completely alien environment literally diving headfirst into another reality the plot showed how pendleton after that very murder scene with the inmate is transported to another prison but the bus gets into an accident this gave murphy a chance to escape in realityand in the alternative world he is essentially also escaping from prison it is no exaggeration to say that the otherworld in downpour is one of the most inventive in the entire series no this isnt about symbolism or visual solutions which are actually quite standard here the same bars chainlink fences rust and blood that have long been firmly associated with silent hill but offering a world that operates by completely different rulesno one had tried that before something vaguely similar could be seen in shattered memories another nonjapanese entry in the series there harry masons world was covered with a thick crust of ice distorting the familiar reality beyond recognition but the space itself remained the same the logic of this new reality murphy finds himself in is very important for understanding the situation the hero is in and no less important for understanding the approach of the czech developers themselves who tried to do something newboth within the genre and the series side quests in one of substories pendleton will enter a movie literally its also worth noting another innovation that was received differently by fans this of course refers to the side quests in the semiopen world for which there were essentially no analogues in any other game these are fullyfledged ministoriesfrom attempts to appease the cursed soul of a murderer to searching for treasure using a cunningly hidden map one of the quests even unlocks a fasttravel system around the town which will be very useful for those planning to thoroughly explore the available content they are all completely optional and mostly designed either to make the players life easier by providing a heap of useful items or to reveal some dark side of the foggy town for example one quest requires correctly placing symbols at certain points in the city thereby performing some kind of ritual the symbols in the tradition of the series are directly borrowed from hermeticism although downpour is a standalone game in the vein of silent hill 2 it actively connects itself with other parts of the series in small details for instance in one of the houses you can find an exact copy of henry townsends apartment from silent hill 4 the room and in the library paintings depicting shepherds glenthe hometown of alex shepherd the hero of silent hill homecominghang on the walls murphy also ended up in this nightmare almost by accident reminiscent of the aforementioned townsend from the fourth game furthermore as in silent hill 2 water plays an important role again hiding certain problems of the hero that he doesnt want to face directly and murphy occasionally meets postal dude blackwood a character from the comic silent hill past life in short there are more than enough connections to the series interestingly it doesnt stop at just small nods and even on the level of mechanics downpour seems to try to emulate its predecessors the weapon in murphys hands constantly breaks leaving him almost helplessjust like in silent hill origins with the caveat that you cant stuff a bunch of hammers into your pockets escape sections from the allconsuming void are accompanied by knocking over crates and the ability to look over your shoulderhello shattered memories and its chase segments in combat against creatures pendleton can use blocking much better than heather from silent hill 3 at the same time each mechanic and reference has been reworked enough that one cannot accuse the authors of blind copying its about being inspired by others and trying to grasp the very essence of the series in order to offer something unique underwater the prison hierarchy in the nightmare world has taken a perverted form and yet its worth returning to the meanings of silent hill downpour with the traditional spoiler disclaimer talking about a psychological horror without touching on its subtext seems rather foolish but lets start from a little further away as already mentioned in the anniversary text about silent hill 2 the image of pyramid head is too firmly entrenched in the minds of fans which resulted in attempts to copy the essence in nonjapanese games of the franchise alex from the fifth part had his own pyramid head the butcher followed travis from origins in downpour there is the bogeymana childrens scary story a giant in a gas mask and cloak with a huge hammer but its meaning radically differs from what was expected while alex and travis spawned monsters themselves with their sick minds murphy is the bogeyman and were not talking about suppressed memories or any other flirtations with the subconscious which one might expect the point is that murphy literally personifies the personal fears of anne cunningham a policewoman seen throughout almost the entire game under various circumstances and the meaning of the giants image is revealed only in the very finale perhaps herein lies the main audacity of the developers they not only put a negative hero in the players hands but also made him a secondary figure in the central storyline of a completely different character about whom practically nothing is known until the final scenes while murphy was experiencing the revenge he had already taken anne was preparing her own which the escaped inmate simply knew nothing about and this much more important script for understanding plays out in the background almost unnoticed by the player the developers only drop small details from which the true picture of events is assembled even the puzzles are themed a police badge with a mourning ribbon a strange silhouette of a cripple in a wheelchair the almost physically palpable hatred of the policewoman who is simply accompanying murphy on his way to a new place of confinement and vague memoriesnot so much of the tragedy that changed anothers life but of her own losses that became the cause of someone elses grief in this regard beneath the layer of awkward mechanics unimpressive visuals and controversial design decisions downpour hides a truly strong story that alas risks being missed and misunderstood precisely because of the chosen narrative method which in fact is the strength of the plot downpour does not try to spoonfeed it literally follows the show dont tell formula revealing a more global picture through small details downpour is a story about revenge that has been taken and revenge that is destined to be taken and only the player with their actions can try to finally break this vicious circle in this sense downpour somewhat resembles the last of us part iianother game attempting to explore revenge as such only where neil druckmann offers a fairly unambiguous interpretation of revenge shouldnt cloud the mind the trio of screenwriters tom waltz tomm hulett and devin shatsky do not try to impose their view on the player whose actions determine the true essence of what happened the root of evil in one of the endings murphy and anne will switch places silent hill downpour in tradition offers several different endingsfrom the familiar to secret and joke ones their conditions are determined both by obvious choices offered by the game and by a hidden morality parameter which also influences the heros pastafter all our actions are dictated by who we really are different players murphys will behave differently some will play a ruthless killer who does not shy away from cruelty and is capable of base acts others on the contrary will try in every way to help people following an almost christian morality by the way in the finale you can listen to a gospel song on one of the radios scattered around the city it is from this that murphys character and whether the title of bogeyman is fair in relation to him are formed for players with low morality the hero will turn out to be the true culprit of annes misfortunes while for those who tried to be a good guy pendleton will still not go to extremes up to the point that in the final cutscene the player is revealed the fact that murphy didnt even manage to finish off napier in this regard downpour resembles another prison horror the suffering in it the main character torque spends the entire game trying to remember whether he actually killed his own family and the truth depends entirely on the players actions in the present perhaps the most interesting ending of downpour in the global context of the series is the third one called full circle in it after all the events of the game murphy finds himself back at the very beginning and is clearly forced to relive his nightmare over and over againapparently until he can finally atone for his sins the theme of return therapy and being in a personal purgatory is one of the central ones for the series about the foggy town already in the first game one of the endings showed that all events are merely the product of the fevered mind of the dying harry who is forced to live through a personal nightmare by the way the new game mode in it is called nowheremany consider this a hint that different playthroughs essentially exist in reality and harry experiences the events again and again all heroes who end up in silent hill find themselves trapped thereif not forever then at least until they can understand something important about themselves in downpour this phenomenon was given a fullfledged name and acknowledged as an important force for the first time silent hill downpour does not aspire to be the best game in the series it has plenty of unsuccessful decisions controversial mechanics and other problems particularly technical onesnot all crashes and frame rate drops were fixed before vatra games was declared bankrupt and yet it shouldnt be written off the czech developers managed to offer an unusual look at such a familiar town showing previously unknown sides of the nightmare behind all the shortcomings lies an excellent game worth digging into for anyone for whom silent hill is more than an empty phrase especially since fans still dont know if a fullfledged sequel will ever see the light of day or not
